<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def ppos(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    return None
print("player:",ppos(current_frame))
action(['RIGHT'])
print("after R:",ppos(current_frame))
# now test ACTION7 (jump?)
action(['ACTION7'])
print("after A7:",ppos(current_frame),"changed=",last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
